name: profile-forge-configurator
description: Web configurator for profile-forge: live preview, then publish config.json, workflow and assets to your profile repo.

paragraphs: Design your card with a live preview, then publish everything to your profile repo in one click. React + TypeScript + Vite, built to a static site.
features: Guided steps: Start (preset, data, general) → Look (themes, colors) → Layout → Details (every section's options) → Content (about, projects, links, tech stack) → Publish. The preview stays visible; on a phone it is a…
Live preview with the real renderer (profile-forge/src/render.js is bundled into the page), dark/light slots, demo data or your own numbers.
Theme gallery with a preview of each of the 47 themes, custom themes, per-color overrides.

Free grid: arrange the card like widgets on a phone. Drag a section on the preview to move it, drag its right edge to resize it (6 columns) and its bottom edge to make it taller (both snap: 6 columns, rows of 80px);…
